data.name: Swarm Trap
data.description: The trap releases a bat swarm, rat swarm, or spider swarm that attacks all creatures in the area. The swarm remains in the general area for no longer than %1 rounds, after which it disperses. If the trap is an extraordinary trap, you must provide the creatures of the swarm (typically in a small box, cage, or crate); these creatures may die of starvation before the trap is triggered (an extraordinary trap lasts %1 days).|SwarmTrapDuration
